# backendruntime — full reference for AI agents

Product: backendruntime.com (currently hosted at https://api.dhirajchapagain.com.np)
Tagline: Enterprise infrastructure for reliable pre-backend mocking.
Positioning: enterprise API validator and builder with mock runtime, rules, auth, webhooks, custom domains, logs, and analytics.

## Concepts

- Workspace: tenant container (slug used in platform mock URLs).
- Collection: group of endpoints; supports import, assign/unassign, deploy-all.
- Endpoint (MockAPI): HTTP method + path + responses + rules + scenarios + auth + rate limit + optional custom domain + version string (default v1).
- Dataset: workspace JSON/faker data usable when designing responses.
- Custom domain: verified via CNAME/TXT/A; endpoints bound to a domain are served at https://domain/path without workspace slug.
- Incoming webhook: receive arbitrary partner callbacks; deliveries are logged.
- Request log: every mock hit records method, path, headers, body, status, latency, scenario, rule/finding, api version, trace-like metadata.

## Auth

- POST /api/v1/auth/register/ {email, password, name?}
- POST /api/v1/auth/login/ {email, password}
- POST /api/v1/auth/google/ {id_token} — verifies Google ID token; if email matches existing user, links Google and returns token; otherwise creates user.
- POST /api/v1/auth/logout/
- GET /api/v1/auth/me/
Header: Authorization: Token <key>

## Workspaces

- GET/POST /api/v1/workspaces/
- GET/PATCH /api/v1/workspaces/{slug}/
- Domains: GET/POST/DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/{slug}/domains/
- Verify: POST /api/v1/workspaces/{slug}/domains/verify/ {id}
- Default domain: POST /api/v1/workspaces/{slug}/domains/set-default/ {id|null}

DNS for custom domains:
- CNAME <your.host> → api.dhirajchapagain.com.np
- Optional TXT _mockapi-verify.<your.host> = verification token
- Prefer Cloudflare proxy ON

## Endpoints (Mock APIs)

- GET /api/v1/apis/?workspace={slug}
- POST /api/v1/apis/
- GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/v1/apis/{id}/
- POST /api/v1/apis/{id}/deploy/
- POST /api/v1/apis/{id}/undeploy/
- POST /api/v1/apis/{id}/clone/
- POST /api/v1/apis/generate/ — deterministic “AI-like” generator (no external LLM)
- POST /api/v1/apis/import_spec/ — Postman / OpenAPI / curl / JSON
- Versions: GET/POST /api/v1/apis/{id}/versions/

Runtime matching: deployed + method + path (+ custom domain binding). Wrong method returns 405 with allowed_methods.

## Collections / datasets / webhooks / logs

- /api/v1/collections/ (+ assign, unassign, deploy_all, apis)
- /api/v1/datasets/
- /api/v1/webhooks/incoming/ (+ deliveries, export)
- /api/v1/webhooks/outgoing/
- Workspace activity/analytics under /api/v1/workspaces/{slug}/analytics/

## Observability

Logs aim for OpenTelemetry-style inspection: trace id / span-like request id, api version, latency_ms, status, scenario, rule finding, request/response payloads, client IP, user agent. Use the Logs UI or RequestLog API fields.
